findings.location: Paragraph beginning "Jesus’ soul-piercing question to Peter was quite simple..." (near the end of the article)
findings.source_quote: Jesus’ soul-piercing question to Peter was quite simple, “Do you love Me?” It was as if Jesus was testing Peter. [“I have a job for you, Peter, but a prerequisite for this job is your devoted love for Me.”]
findings.suggested_fix: Change the Spanish so the question is described as piercing Peter’s soul (the intended meaning), not piercing Jesus’ soul. Preserve structure and tags. Suggested Spanish: "La pregunta de Jesús, que traspasó el alma de Pedro, fue bastante simple: “¿Me amas?” Era como si Jesús estuviera probando a Pedro. [“Tengo un trabajo para ti, Pedro, pero un requisito previo para este trabajo es tu amor devoto por mí.”]"
findings.translation_quote: La pregunta que traspasó el alma de Jesús a Pedro fue bastante simple: “¿Me amas?” Era como si Jesús estuviera probando a Pedro. [“Tengo un trabajo para ti, Pedro, pero un requisito previo para este trabajo es tu amor devoto por mí.”]
